items.headline: HSBC remains confident in Gulf real estate despite regional conflicts.
items.summary: The British bank's CEO stated there are no major concerns regarding regional property exposure or corporate loan books. Provisions of nearly $400 million have been set aside for potential loan losses.
items.why: It shows major banking confidence in regional real estate stability amidst geopolitical tensions.
items.impact_reason: Signals strong banking sector confidence during regional market volatility.

items.headline: Sharjah introduces three bus routes linking to Etihad Rail.

items.why: Improved regional connectivity positively influences property demand and accessibility in connected areas.
items.impact_reason: Better transport links enhance regional property accessibility and appeal.

bullets: On Monday 19 October, DLD recorded 702 sales worth AED 1.7bn, which is 3.1% below a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 69.2% of Monday's sales, compared to 65.2% over the last 7 days.
The median price per square foot was 1,720 AED, up 4.3% against the 30-day average and up 1.0% compared to last year.
In September new rental contracts for a 1-bedroom apartment in JVC reached a median of 69,000 AED a year, up 3.2% on the month.
Over the last 7 days, Dubai South (DWC) led with 290 sales, followed by JVC with 188 and Majan with 126.
